name: supkube-mcp

prd004_skills.name: list_k8s_workloads
prd004_skills.description: List namespaces with workload counts and backup protection status.

prd004_skills.name: get_backup_advice
prd004_skills.description: Backup Advisor recommendation for a namespace (score/tier/factors). Proxies live backend Advisor.

prd004_skills.name: create_backup_policy
prd004_skills.description: Create a backup policy (schedule). Dry-run + confirm_id first; execute on confirm (ADR-057).

prd004_skills.name: trigger_backup_execution
prd004_skills.description: Run an existing backup policy immediately (run-once). Dry-run + confirm_id first; execute on confirm (ADR-057).

orchestration_extras.name: get_restore_status
orchestration_extras.description: Restore status summary. Authoritative status for reliable waiting (SupInsight #3).

orchestration_extras.name: trigger_restore
orchestration_extras.description: Trigger a Velero restore. Dry-run + confirm_id first; execute on confirm (ADR-057).

hitl.flow: write skill first call returns requires_confirmation + dry_run + confirm_id; second call with confirm_id executes using the SNAPSHOT inputs (2nd-call inputs ignored), one-shot, 5-min TTL
hitl.store: PoC = in-memory; production = K8s CR (cross-replica), per ADR-057
hitl.unifies: MCP write-skill HitL == PRD-013 four-eyes == orchestration high-risk approval (one mechanism)

notes: PRD-004's 5 locked skills all registered + 2 restore extras for orchestration. list_k8s_workloads returns per-namespace counts (full per-workload needs a backend endpoint). get_backup_advice proxies the live /backup-advisor endpoint (full PRD-003 productionization is a separate gate).
